task:
A fund holds 2063 credits. Its first grant is 21% of that original balance. Return 47% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 9% of the original balance minus 9 credits (the 9 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer.
